answer_1.quote: We evaluated our approach on the widely used XSum dataset, ... focusing on abstractive summarization.

answer_2.quote: We report the common lexical n-gram overlap evaluation metrics and a set of factual consistency metrics... For factual consistency, we report NLI and the Q2 score.

answer_4.quote: We asked human evaluators to rate a sample of the XSum test-set ... we pose 4 questions outlining comprehensibility, attribution, salience and conciseness.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters answered four questions on comprehension, attribution, salience, and conciseness for each summary.
